# @zakkster/lite-media

> Reactive media, container-query, and preference signals built on
> @zakkster/lite-signal. Wraps window.matchMedia AND the browser's native
> @container evaluator in Signal<boolean>. Page-lifetime memoization by exact
> query string. Zero-GC steady state. One runtime dep (@zakkster/lite-signal).
> ESM-only. MIT. v1.1.0 ships Engine A (viewport & preferences) + Engine B
> (containerMedia) + createMedia() scoped instances. v1.1.2 adds a dev-only
> container-type footgun warning (dropped in production), pins the SSR
> container contract and registry-bounds invariant, and adds test/torture.mjs.

## Design in one line

JS never evaluates a query. The browser evaluates via matchMedia (Engine A)
or the native @container evaluator (Engine B); lite-media observes the
verdict and pushes a boolean into the lite-signal graph.

Consequences:
- Correctness for free: range syntax, em, dvh, container queries, cqw,
  style() — the browser handles them. No JS parser to maintain.
- Zero-GC steady state: a change/transitionrun event runs one hoisted
  handler that does one sig.set(). lite-signal's Object.is drops redundant
  events. No timers, no debounce, no schedulers.

## Numbers (Apple M4 Pro · 12 cores · Node 26.3.1 · darwin/arm64)

| Scenario                                    | Throughput      | Per-op         |
|---------------------------------------------|-----------------|----------------|
| media() cache hit                           | 213 M ops/s     | 4.7 ns         |
| Signal read (call-style s())                | 1.44 B ops/s    | 0.7 ns         |
| Preference shortcut cache hit               | 187 M ops/s     | 5.4 ns         |
| change event → sig.set → effect (1 sub)     | 46 M ops/s      | 21.8 ns        |
| Fanout to 100 subscribers                   | 849 K ops/s     | 1.18 μs / ~12 ns per sub |
| createMedia() instance creation             | 21 M ops/s      | 47.8 ns        |
| Cold materialize (mock MQL, cache miss)     | 1.6 M ops/s     | 624 ns         |
| createMedia() + 5 signals wired             | 674 K ops/s     | 1.48 μs        |

Bundle size: ~2,270 B min+gz for the full module (bundled, lite-signal
external). The dev-only container-type warning sits behind a
`process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"` guard, so a production build drops it.
Run `npm run bench` locally; the harness prints a machine stamp so results are
reproducible. Allocation claims are committed as numbers by `npm run
test:torture` (node --expose-gc): 0 B/flip on both engines, 0 ArrayBuffer
growth, 0 major GC across a 100-signal x 2000-toggle storm.

## Public API (v1.1.0)

    import { signal, effect } from "@zakkster/lite-signal";
    import {
        media, containerMedia, createMedia, configure, stats,
        reducedMotion, darkScheme, hoverCapable, coarsePointer,
        forcedColors, moreContrast, reducedData, reducedTransparency,
        __resetForTests, __flipForTests,
    } from "@zakkster/lite-media";

### media(query: string): MediaSignal

Memoized reactive boolean for a CSS media query. Same query string ⇒ same
signal instance. Signal has (): boolean tracked read, .peek(): boolean
untracked read, .subscribe(fn): dispose. .set / .update hidden by TypeScript.

Throws Error if no matchMedia and no ssrDefault. Throws TypeError if the
configured factory returns a non-MQL-shaped object.

Failed materialization does NOT engage the lock. Caller can configure() and
retry.

### containerMedia(el: Element, query: string): MediaSignal — new in 1.1

Memoized reactive boolean for a container query, scoped to an element.
Cached per (element, query) pair via a WeakMap keyed on the element.

Under the hood: lite-media injects one @container rule per unique query
into a shared stylesheet, appends a zero-size sentinel div to the container,
and listens for transitionrun on a registered <custom-ident> CSS custom
property (--lm-v) that flips off↔on when the container matches.

Preconditions (BOTH must hold):
1. The element (or an ancestor) establishes a query container via
   container-type: size | inline-size. The library cannot set it for you — it
   would over-specify layout. In DEV builds, if neither the element nor any
   ancestor is a query container, a one-time console.warn names the element and
   the fix (warn, never mutate). Gated on process.env.NODE_ENV, so a production
   build drops it.
2. Query strings come from a bounded static set. They're inserted into a
   live stylesheet, so untrusted input is an XSS-adjacent bug in the caller.

In environments without container queries / adoptedStyleSheets /
allow-discrete transitions, the signal stays at initial:false. Graceful
degradation, not runtime error. Off-DOM (SSR / Node without a container
engine) containerMedia() returns a stable false signal and never throws — the
conservative, fail-closed verdict. Unlike media(), ssrDefault does NOT apply
to this path.

Throws TypeError if el is null/primitive or query is not a string.

### createMedia(options?): ScopedMedia — new in 1.1

Fundamental factory. Module-level media/configure/preferences/containerMedia
delegate to a lazily-created default instance backed by this.

Options are creation-only. Scoped instances never lock — no configure()
step, no lock error. Instance shape mirrors module surface minus configure()
and __resetForTests().

    interface CreateMediaOptions {
        matchMedia?: (q: string) => MockMediaQueryList;
        ssrDefault?: boolean;
        containerEngine?: ContainerEngine | null;
    }

    interface ScopedMedia {
        media(q: string): MediaSignal;
        containerMedia(el, q: string): MediaSignal;
        reducedMotion(): MediaSignal;
        darkScheme(): MediaSignal;
        // ... 6 more preferences
        stats(): Stats;
    }

Use for:
- Per-request SSR (fresh instance per request; UA-derived ssrDefault works).
- Tests that need isolation without module-state mutation.
- Multi-mount pages with different mocks / defaults / engines.

Throws TypeError if containerEngine is malformed.

### configure(options): void

Configures the DEFAULT instance. Must be called before first successful
media()/containerMedia()/preference call.

    options.matchMedia — (q: string) => MediaQueryList-shaped.
                         Non-function throws TypeError.
                         Falls through to globalThis.matchMedia when unset.
    options.ssrDefault — boolean. Non-boolean (incl undefined) is a no-op.
                         Process-wide constant on the default instance.
    options.containerEngine — { watch(el, q, onChange): { initial, dispose } }.
                              Falls through to browser or Node inert default.
                              Malformed shape throws TypeError.

Silently ignores null/undefined/non-object. Multiple pre-lock calls compose.
Post-lock throws Error. Failed materialization does NOT lock.

### Preference shortcuts

Each is () => MediaSignal, delegating to media() with a fixed query.
Available on both the module-level default and scoped instances.

    reducedMotion       — (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
    darkScheme          — (prefers-color-scheme: dark)
    hoverCapable        — (hover: hover)
    coarsePointer       — (pointer: coarse)
    forcedColors        — (forced-colors: active)
    moreContrast        — (prefers-contrast: more)
    reducedData         — (prefers-reduced-data: reduce)
    reducedTransparency — (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce)

### stats(): Stats

    watched     — memoized signal count in cache
    configured  — matchMedia/ssrDefault/containerEngine explicitly set?
    locked      — successful materialization has happened (always false on
                  scoped instances)

### __resetForTests(): void

@internal. Clears default-instance cache, config slots, lock, and cached
bound native matchMedia.

## Types

    interface MediaSignal {
        (): boolean;                                    // tracked read
        peek(): boolean;                                // untracked read
        subscribe(fn: (v: boolean) => void): () => void;
    }

    interface MockMediaQueryList {
        matches: boolean;
        addEventListener(
            type: "change",
            handler: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void
        ): void;
    }

    interface ContainerEngine {
        watch(
            el: Element | object,
            query: string,
            onChange: (matches: boolean) => void
        ): { initial: boolean; dispose: () => void };
    }

    interface Stats { watched: number; configured: boolean; locked: boolean; }

## Read-only by convention

MediaSignal hides .set/.update in the .d.ts. Runtime object IS a lite-signal
Signal, so JS or TS-cast can write. Doing so permanently desyncs from the
browser until the next real change event. If you need write access, wrap in
a computed() you own.

## Memoization contract

media() and containerMedia() memoize by exact string match, lifetime of the
instance (no eviction). Query strings MUST come from a bounded static set.

    // WRONG — leaks a signal + a listener per unique width, plus for
    // containerMedia a live CSS rule.
    for (let w = 300; w < 1300; w++) media(`(max-width: ${w}px)`);

For containerMedia, the query is additionally inserted into a live
stylesheet — untrusted input is XSS-adjacent.

## Allocation profile

    Op                                      | Allocations
    --------------------------------------- | -----------
    media(q) cache hit                      | 0 hot-path
    media(q) cache miss (mock)              | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL
    media(q) cache miss (native, 1st)       | + 1 bound-native fn (cached)
    media(q) cache miss (native, ≥2)        | 1 signal + 1 handler + 1 MQL
    containerMedia(el, q) cache hit         | 0 hot-path
    containerMedia(el, q) miss (1st query)  | sentinel + handler + signal + CSS rule + property (once)
    containerMedia(el, q) miss (≥2 query)   | sentinel + handler + signal
    Signal read s()                         | 0
    change event → sig.set                  | 0
    transitionrun event → sig.set           | 0 hot-path
    Redundant event (same value)            | 0 (Object.is dedup)
    Preference shortcut call                | 0 additional
    createMedia(opts) call                  | 1 instance + 1 Map + 1 WeakMap

Cost scales with verdict flips, not with browser events.

## When to use / not use

USE for:
- Twitch overlays and embedded widgets where every ms matters.
- Component libraries with breakpoint / preference / container-query gating.
- Test suites needing honest boolean semantics via mocks.
- Per-request SSR (via createMedia()).

DO NOT USE for:
- Pure feature detection (matchMedia is the wrong tool; use @supports).
- Unbounded/dynamic query strings (see Memoization contract).
- Untrusted queries — especially for containerMedia (CSS injection).

## SSR / testing

Server-side, three options:

1) Process-wide default (constant across all requests):

    configure({ ssrDefault: false });
    const s = media("(any)"); // returns false without a browser

2) Per-request scoped instance (v1.1):

    export function handle(req) {
        const m = createMedia({ ssrDefault: guessMobile(req.headers.ua) });
        const s = m.media("(max-width: 600px)");
        return render({ compact: s() });
    }

3) Mock factory (for tests):

    configure({
        matchMedia: (q) => ({
            matches: false,
            addEventListener() {},
        }),
    });

Node's --test runs each file in a subprocess by default, giving free
cross-file isolation. Within a file, __resetForTests() in beforeEach.

## Container-query test seam

Mock the container engine directly:

    const mockEngine = {
        watch(el, q, onChange) {
            registry.set(key(el, q), onChange);
            return { initial: false, dispose() { registry.delete(key(el, q)); } };
        },
    };
    configure({ containerEngine: mockEngine });
    // or: createMedia({ containerEngine: mockEngine });

## Browser & runtime support

Pure ES2020. matchMedia requires globalThis.matchMedia or a mock.
containerMedia additionally requires container queries (Chrome 105+,
Firefox 110+, Safari 16+), adoptedStyleSheets (Chrome 96+, Firefox 101+,
Safari 16.4+), and transition-behavior: allow-discrete (Chrome 117+,
Firefox 129+, Safari 17.4+) — all Baseline 2024.

Older browsers: containerMedia returns a signal stuck at initial:false.
Not a runtime error, just graceful degradation.

## Roadmap

- 1.0.0 — Engine A: media(), 8 preferences, configure, stats.
- 1.1.0 — Engine B: containerMedia. createMedia() scoped instances.
- 1.1.2 — Dev-only container-type warning; SSR container contract +
          registry-bounds invariant pinned; test/torture.mjs proof gate.
- 1.2.0 — breakpoints({ sm, md, lg }) interned-token computed; reconsider
          standaloneDisplay / highDynamicRange based on consumer demand.
- 1.3.0 — Shadow DOM multi-root support for engine B; iframe / Twitch
          panel-mode verification pass.
- 1.4.0 — Ecosystem wiring: lite-ambient-fx & lite-scratch-fx consume
          reducedMotion via watchEffect rAF gate; lite-hueforge pairs
          moreContrast / forcedColors with APCA role-floor selection.

Watchlist: CSSWG #6205 (native Element.matchContainer). If it ships, engine
B collapses to a feature-detected bridge with unchanged signal-graph surface.

## File layout

    Media.js       — single-file ESM implementation (~450 lines)
    Media.d.ts     — TypeScript declarations
    test/01…10-*.test.mjs      — 90 tests across 10 files
    bench/bench.mjs — machine-stamped benchmark harness
    demo/index.html — 6-scene oscilloscope demo
    README.md, llms.txt, LICENSE.txt, CHANGELOG.md

## Install

    npm install @zakkster/lite-media @zakkster/lite-signal
